Redesign the success result section in the widget Live Preview on the Widget Customization page. The file is `/Users/yashbaldha/Desktop/Shopify App/Pinzo/app/routes/app.widget.tsx`.

## Current Problem
The success result in the Live Preview looks like plain text noise — just a list of lines with small icons. It needs to feel like a modern app UI, not a text dump.

## What to redesign
Only the **success result** preview section (when `previewState === "success"`). Do NOT touch the inline/floating/popup container code, the CSS generation functions, or the storefront widget code.

## Read the file first
Read the full file to understand the structure, then find the success result section (around lines 770-802). It currently renders:
- A `.zcc-result.ok` div with icon + message
- Meta lines for ETA, zone, days, cutoff
- COD badge
- Return policy line

## New Design Direction
Replace the success result JSX with a clean, modern card-based layout using ONLY inline styles (no new CSS classes — this is a preview component). The design should feel like a premium delivery tracking app:

1. **Success header** — Green checkmark icon + success message on a subtle green background strip
2. **Delivery info cards** — Instead of plain text lines, show ETA and Zone as two side-by-side mini cards (like stat boxes) with the value prominent and label below
3. **Schedule row** — Days + cutoff time on a single clean row with subtle separators
4. **COD badge** — Keep as a pill/badge but make it more prominent with an icon
5. **Return policy** — Subtle footer text

Key principles:
- Use `cfg.successColor` for the green accents (available as `effectiveCfg.successColor`)
- Use `cfg.primaryColor` for any brand-colored accents
- Use `cfg.textColor` for text
- Use `cfg.backgroundColor` for backgrounds
- Keep font sizes small (12-14px) since this renders inside a preview panel
- No raw HTML divs for Polaris layout — this is inside a preview iframe-like area, inline styles are correct here
- Keep the existing SVG icons (checkCircle, truck, location, calendar, clock, card, refresh icons are already defined as variables)

## Important
- Only change the success result JSX block
- Keep all the same conditional checks (showEta, showZone, showDeliveryDays, showCutoffTime, showCod, showReturnPolicy)
- Keep using the existing icon variables (checkCircleIcon, truckIcon, locationIcon, calendarIcon, clockIcon, cardIcon, refreshIcon)
- Run `npm run typecheck` after changes

Do NOT modify:
- The CSS generation functions (buildWidgetCss, buildAdminPreviewCss, etc.)
- The floating/popup/inline preview components
- The storefront widget liquid file
- Any loader/action code

Zero errors. Here is a summary of every change made.

---

## What changed

**File:** `/Users/yashbaldha/Desktop/Shopify App/Pinzo/app/routes/app.widget.tsx`

### New icon added (line ~716)
`locationIcon` — a map-pin SVG using `metaIconStyle`, used for the Zone stat card. Inserted immediately before `checkCircleIcon`.

### Success result block redesigned (lines ~782–955)
The old flat `.zcc-result.ok` div-with-text-rows was replaced with a four-layer card built entirely from inline styles:

| Layer | What it renders | Colors used |
|---|---|---|
| **Success header strip** | Circle avatar with checkmark + success message text on a tinted gradient bar | `successColor` for icon, text, and gradient tint |
| **ETA + Zone stat cards** | Two side-by-side mini cards with a bold value, small uppercase label row, and subtle descriptor. Separated by a 1px vertical divider. Only renders when the respective toggle is on. | `successColor` for truck icon tint; `primaryColor` for location icon tint; `textColor` for the value |
| **Schedule row** | Delivery days pills + cutoff time on one horizontal line separated by a 1px hairline. Only renders when either toggle is on. | `textColor` for the cutoff time value; muted grey for icons |
| **Footer row** | COD pill badge (rounded, brand-tinted) on the left; return policy text on the right. Only renders when either toggle is on. | `successColor` for COD badge background, border, and text |

### What was not touched
- `buildWidgetCss`, `buildSharedMetaCss`, `scopeAdminCss` — no changes
- `FloatingPreview`, `PopupPreview` components — no changes
- Loader, action, form state, save/reset logic — no changes
- Error and not-found result blocks — no changes
- All conditional checks (`showEta`, `showZone`, `showDeliveryDays`, `showCutoffTime`, `showCod`, `showReturnPolicy`) are preserved exactly
